svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 02 · Berkeley · 07/12 Strawberry Creek (Common)
svg.desc: A creek runs right through campus under little footbridges. Stop and listen for it. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
